vassals.title: Warden
grievances: House Alabrook ruled Svaiyimlal until 280 and has never forgotten it.

hooks.title: A Lord in Revolt
hooks.text: Warden Gliriel of Vilmoth has closed the gates to the crown's tax-gatherers. House Alabrook ruled Svaiyimlal until 280 and has never forgotten it. Hierarch Naethar the Generous needs a go-between before blood is spilt.

hooks.title: Wagons Turned Back
hooks.text: Grand Syndic Tony the Tall has closed the border to carts from Svaiyimlal, and the carters' guild is threatening to march on Svaiyimvith. Hierarch Naethar the Generous needs proof the blockade breaks an old treaty.

hooks.title: A Crown Contested
hooks.text: Hierarch Naethar the Generous came to power only 13 years ago, and Warden Gliriel of House Alabrook has never accepted it. Letters are passing between the claimant and lords who remember the old house.

hooks.title: Opened Graves
hooks.text: Old graves from the Hollow Fever of 255 have been opened in the night. The folk of Svaiyimlal whisper that someone wants the sickness back.

hooks.title: The Tax Strike
hooks.text: Hierarch Naethar the Generous takes 14 in every hundred on trade, about 17976 sp a year, and the towns grumble. A pamphleteer calling for a tax strike must be found, or protected, depending on who pays.

reasons: About 11,771 sp of goods pass between them each year.
They have fought two wars in recorded memory.
One settlement changed hands between them by the sword.
Their peoples share a tongue and customs.
About 3,321 sp of goods pass between them each year.
They have fought four wars in recorded memory.
Four settlements changed hands between them by the sword.
The last war between them ended only 25 years ago.

events.title: The great flood at Svaiyimvith
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Svaiyimvith stand in brown water.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Thieeliebrook over its banks in 20, and Svaiyimvith was caught asleep.

events.title: Svaiyimvith raises the banner of Svaiyimlal
events.text: At Svaiyimvith the headmen of the country swear to one banner, and Svaiyimlal begins.

events.title: The first lords of Svaiyimlal
events.text: House Thiaglen takes the lordship of Svaiyimlal at its founding.

events.title: Hierarch Thienda of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Svaiyimlal bows to Thienda, newly crowned Hierarch, of House Thiaglen.

events.title: Hierarch Miewen of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Miewen takes the seat of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: The Fitheil War
events.text: Old grievances at Fitheil set Frigmo and Svaiyimlal at each other's throats.
events.name: The Fitheil War
events.backstory: Frigmo raised the toll on Fitheil bridge, Svaiyimlal refused to pay, and the Fitheil War was the result.

events.title: The Treaty of Fitheil
events.text: After years of burnt barns and empty cradles, Frigmo and Svaiyimlal agree that nothing was worth it, and change no boundary.

events.title: Hierarch Gliwen of Svaiyimlal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Gliwen of House Thiaglen becomes Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: House Aliebrook elected in Svaiyimlal
events.text: Delegates gather at Svaiyimvith and, after three days of argument, choose House Aliebrook to rule Svaiyimlal.
events.name: The Choosing of 100
events.backstory: In 100 a vote at Svaiyimvith ended the rule of Thiaglen, and House Aliebrook has held Svaiyimlal since.

events.title: Hierarch Laera the Lame of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Laera the Lame takes the seat of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: The Teafithlal Reckoning at Vichvochchor
events.text: Envoys from Teafithlal and Svaiyimlal part in anger at Vichvochchor, and within the season both are mustering.
events.name: The Teafithlal Reckoning at Vichvochchor
events.backstory: It began as an argument over tolls at Vichvochchor, and by 104 both Teafithlal and Svaiyimlal had armies in the field.

events.title: Hierarch Mianynden of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Mianynden of House Aliebrook is raised as Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: Vilmoth in flames
events.text: A fire in the lower lanes burns a third of Vilmoth.
events.name: The Burning Night of Vilmoth
events.backstory: The blaze began with a forgotten lamp in a chandler's loft; by morning Vilmoth was ash.

events.title: The Treaty of Vichvochchor
events.text: Teafithlal has the better of it, and Svaiyimlal gives up Vichvochchor.

events.title: Vichvochchor passes to Teafithlal
events.text: The folk of Vichvochchor wake to find themselves subjects of Teafithlal.
events.backstory: After the Teafithlal Reckoning at Vichvochchor, the people of Vichvochchor found their new lords had little interest in their old customs.

events.title: The Fithveamsai Quarrel
events.text: Raiding and reprisals around Fithveamsai turn into open war between Frigmo and Svaiyimlal.
events.name: The Fithveamsai Quarrel
events.backstory: Merchants complained of bribes and double charges at Fithveamsai until Frigmo and Svaiyimlal chose swords over ledgers.

events.title: Sheep replace the folk of Sywood
events.text: Sheep are worth more to the lord than tenants, and the shepherds' steading at Sywood is cleared.

events.title: The Peace of Fithveamsai
events.text: Neither side can claim victory; Frigmo and Svaiyimlal swap hostages and go home.

events.title: The electors of Svaiyimlal choose
events.text: With no clear heir, the notables of Svaiyimlal vote, and House Elathorn wins by a handful of voices.
events.name: The Choosing of 132
events.backstory: The custom of Svaiyimlal is to choose its rulers, and in 132 the electors passed over Aliebrook for House Elathorn.

events.title: Hierarch Vierylar the Patient of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Svaiyimlal bows to Vierylar the Patient, newly crowned Hierarch, of House Elathorn.

events.title: The Salt Shivers at Teafitheil
events.text: Carried along the roads from Teafitheil, it empties houses in Koth, Haf, Bonlypor and 92 other places.
events.name: The Salt Shivers
events.backstory: The Salt Shivers began in Teafitheil in 133, where drinking water had been tainted ever since the Drowning of Thvuldaem.

events.title: Breinaness is abandoned
events.text: The sickness has emptied Breinaness; the survivors burn their belongings and walk away from the farmstead.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Salt Shivers reached Breinaness; by 133 the farmstead was empty.

events.title: Silence at Elaliglade
events.text: No one will touch the doors of Elaliglade after the fever, and the salt-works village slowly returns to the wild.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Salt Shivers refused to remain at Elaliglade, and the salt-works village was left to the weeds in 136.

events.title: The Lad flood
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Lad and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Thieeliebrook over its banks in 146, and Lad was caught asleep.

events.title: A vote at Svaiyimvith
events.text: Delegates gather at Svaiyimvith and, after three days of argument, choose House Niawood to rule Svaiyimlal.
events.name: The Choosing of 147
events.backstory: The custom of Svaiyimlal is to choose its rulers, and in 147 the electors passed over Elathorn for House Niawood.

events.title: Hierarch Elyra of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Svaiyimlal bows to Elyra, newly crowned Hierarch, of House Niawood.

events.title: Aliahollow is abandoned
events.text: Aliahollow is attacked in the dark twice in a year, and the shepherds' steading is then left to the owls.

events.title: The Iflafith flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Iflafith.
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Thieeliebrook through Iflafith in 148.

events.title: The great flood at Flamothveamsai
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Athifd and Flamothveamsai and down into the cellars.
events.name: The Flood of the Broken Banks of 151
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Thieeliebrook through Flamothveamsai in 151.

events.title: The Rochogond flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Rochogond.
events.backstory: The Thieeliebrook rose a fathom in a night in 156, and Rochogond had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: Hierarch Alierion of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Alierion takes the seat of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: High water at Lagism
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Slalf and Lagism.
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Thieeliebrook through Lagism in 169.

events.title: House Alialeaf elected in Svaiyimlal
events.text: Delegates gather at Svaiyimvith and, after three days of argument, choose House Alialeaf to rule Svaiyimlal.
events.name: The Choosing of 172
events.backstory: In 172 a vote at Svaiyimvith ended the rule of Niawood, and House Alialeaf has held Svaiyimlal since.

events.title: Hierarch Fynen of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Svaiyimlal bows to Fynen, newly crowned Hierarch, of House Alialeaf.

events.title: The Adiveamsai flood
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Athifd and Adiveamsai.
events.backstory: The Thieeliebrook rose a fathom in a night in 174, and Adiveamsai had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: The Svaiyimvith flood
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Svaiyimvith and Slalf.
events.name: The Flood of the Broken Banks
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Thieeliebrook over its banks in 184, and Svaiyimvith was caught asleep.

events.title: Gleglade lost to the water
events.text: The river takes the well, the fields and the footbridge of Gleglade, and the cottar row is let go.
events.backstory: After the Flood of the Broken Banks the people of Gleglade rebuilt nothing; the cottar row was empty by 185.

events.title: Silt over Symere
events.text: The flood leaves Symere under silt; nobody rebuilds the mill hamlet.
events.backstory: The Flood of the Broken Banks left Symere a swamp, and the mill hamlet was abandoned in 186.

events.title: Glaglen lost to the water
events.text: Silt a hand deep covers every floor in Glaglen; the folk take what floats and leave for Svaiyimvith.
events.backstory: After the Flood of the Broken Banks the people of Glaglen rebuilt nothing; the charcoal-burners' camp was empty by 186.

events.title: The Vilmid flood
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Vilmid and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Thieeliebrook through Vilmid in 198.

events.title: Rybrook is abandoned
events.text: Rybrook is attacked in the dark twice in a year, and the walled village is then left to the owls.

events.title: A vote at Svaiyimvith
events.text: The ring of the elders is passed to House Vaeglen, and Svaiyimlal has a new ruling family.
events.name: The Moot of Vaeglen
events.backstory: The custom of Svaiyimlal is to choose its rulers, and in 206 the electors passed over Alialeaf for House Vaeglen.

events.title: Hierarch Niara of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Niara takes the seat of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: The War of Lilisos
events.text: Old grievances at Lilisos set Frigmo and Svaiyimlal at each other's throats.
events.name: The War of Lilisos
events.backstory: Frigmo raised the toll on Lilisos bridge, Svaiyimlal refused to pay, and the War of Lilisos was the result.

events.title: High water at Lofithlafith
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Lofithlafith.
events.name: The Thieeliebrook Rising of 224
events.backstory: The Thieeliebrook rose a fathom in a night in 224, and Lofithlafith had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: High water at Lavith
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Lavith and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: The Thieeliebrook rose a fathom in a night in 229, and Lavith had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: Collapse at the Withra mines
events.text: Old galleries give way beneath Withra, burying a shift of miners.
events.backstory: The pit props at Withra had not been replaced in years, and in 230 the roof gave way without warning.

events.title: The Zchilichod Troubles
events.text: Old grievances at Zchilichod set Teafithlal and Svaiyimlal at each other's throats.
events.name: The Zchilichod Troubles
events.backstory: Merchants complained of bribes and double charges at Zchilichod until Teafithlal and Svaiyimlal chose swords over ledgers.

events.title: The Truce at Lilisos
events.text: Terms are read out at Lilisos: Lilisos and Lithkolf to Frigmo, and a promise of quiet from Svaiyimlal.

events.title: The new border at Lithkolf
events.text: Surveyors from Frigmo drive new stakes at Lithkolf, and Svaiyimlal does not send anyone to pull them up.
events.backstory: Frigmo claimed Lithkolf as the price of the War of Lilisos, and Svaiyimlal was in no position to refuse.

events.title: Frigmo takes Lilisos
events.text: Surveyors from Frigmo drive new stakes at Lilisos, and Svaiyimlal does not send anyone to pull them up.
events.backstory: Frigmo claimed Lilisos as the price of the War of Lilisos, and Svaiyimlal was in no position to refuse.

events.title: The Truce at Zchilichod
events.text: A truce is cried at Zchilichod; Teafithlal and Svaiyimlal both claim the credit and keep their land.

events.title: Hierarch Vera the Red of Svaiyimlal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Vera the Red of House Vaeglen becomes Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: The Rorern flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Rorern.
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Thieeliebrook through Rorern in 235.

events.title: The great flood at Tithvulafith
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Svaiyimvith and Tithvulafith.
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Thieeliebrook through Tithvulafith in 237.

events.title: The old line of Svaiyimlal ends
events.text: House Alabrook has the nearest claim on the vacant crown of Svaiyimlal, and nobody is in a position to dispute it.
events.name: The Heirless Winter of Svaiyimlal
events.backstory: With no heir of Vaeglen to be had, Svaiyimlal chose House Alabrook, who were distant cousins at best.

events.title: Hierarch Mysa of Svaiyimlal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Mysa of House Alabrook becomes Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: High water at Tveehol
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Tveehol and down into the cellars.
events.name: The Flood of the Broken Banks of 244
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Thieeliebrook through Tveehol in 244.

events.title: Miners lost at Girse
events.text: Old galleries give way beneath Girse, burying a shift of miners.
events.backstory: The mine owners at Girse skimped on props, and the miners paid for it in 246.

events.title: The Svaiyimvith flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Svaiyimvith, Id, Slalf and 2 other places.
events.backstory: The Thieeliebrook rose a fathom in a night in 247, and Svaiyimvith had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: The Ronich flood
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Ronich stand in brown water.
events.name: The Flood of the Broken Banks of 247
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Thieeliebrook carried the whole winter down on Ronich.

events.title: Silt over Meglen
events.text: Meglen sits too low, and after the water the mill hamlet is not worth the digging out.
events.backstory: The Flood of the Broken Banks of 244 left Meglen a swamp, and the mill hamlet was abandoned in 247.

events.title: Hierarch Riasil of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Riasil takes the seat of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: The Hollow Fever comes to Frigmo
events.text: It breaks out in Hvifchifrenorn and spreads to Hraanogrim, Imregeot, Aasmoflal and 160 other places.
events.name: The Hollow Fever
events.backstory: Years of hunger after the Mefleet Hunger had left the folk of Hvifchifrenorn too weak to fight off the Hollow Fever, which took hold in 248.

events.title: Faehollow is abandoned
events.text: Raiders strike Faehollow twice in a year; the survivors take refuge in Slalf.

events.title: The Burneut flood
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Burneut.
events.name: The Great Thieeliebrook Spate
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Thieeliebrook carried the whole winter down on Burneut.

events.title: Famine in Svaiyimlal
events.text: Hunger spreads across Svaiyimvith, Vilmoth, Hidmak and 208 other places, and the granaries stand empty.
events.name: The Black Granary Winters
events.backstory: The silt left by the Great Thieeliebrook Spate ruined the next sowing, and the hungry years of Svaiyimlal followed.

events.title: Hunger empties Ruthorpe
events.text: Ruthorpe cannot feed itself, so the charcoal-burners' camp walks to Neren and does not return.
events.backstory: Folk of Ruthorpe walked away from the Black Granary Winters, and the charcoal-burners' camp was abandoned in 249.

events.title: Hunger empties Skibraby
events.text: Hunger drives the people of Skibraby to Reglypor, and the hamlet is left empty.
events.backstory: Folk of Skibraby walked away from the Black Granary Winters, and the hamlet was abandoned in 249.

events.title: Skyholm is abandoned
events.text: Skyholm cannot feed itself, so the hunters' lodge walks to Gehrythegurn and does not return.
events.backstory: The Black Granary Winters starved Skyholm; the hunters' lodge was left in 250.

events.title: Silence at Fieliabrook
events.text: The sickness has emptied Fieliabrook; the survivors burn their belongings and walk away from the hamlet.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Hollow Fever reached Fieliabrook; by 250 the hamlet was empty.

events.title: The hungry road from Raibury
events.text: Hunger drives the people of Raibury to Neren, and the farmstead is left empty.
events.backstory: By 252, the Black Granary Winters had emptied the farmstead of Raibury.

events.title: The Hollow Fever of 255
events.text: First seen at Daapaanrenorn, the sickness follows carters and pilgrims to Lisnok, Svaiyimvith, Lasveamsai and 158 other places.
events.name: The Hollow Fever of 255
events.backstory: Years of hunger after the Black Granary Winters had left the folk of Daapaanrenorn too weak to fight off the Hollow Fever of 255, which took hold in 255.

events.title: Laesteiby is abandoned
events.text: The last families leave Laesteiby after the sickness, and the hunters' lodge falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The Hollow Fever of 255 emptied Laesteiby, and the hunters' lodge was abandoned in 255.

events.title: Silence at Sebrook
events.text: No one will touch the doors of Sebrook after the fever, and the market village slowly returns to the wild.
events.backstory: The Hollow Fever of 255 emptied Sebrook, and the market village was abandoned in 256.

events.title: Stovik is abandoned
events.text: The last families leave Stovik after the sickness, and the village falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The Hollow Fever of 255 emptied Stovik, and the village was abandoned in 257.

events.title: High water at Gvithf
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Gvithf, Fealulm and Mivafm.
events.name: The Thieeliebrook Rising of 259
events.backstory: A warm wind in 259 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Thieeliebrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: The great flood at Lihalafith
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Id and Lihalafith and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Thieeliebrook over its banks in 260, and Lihalafith was caught asleep.

events.title: The War of the Svaiyimlal Marches
events.text: Old grievances at Lithf set Frigmo and Svaiyimlal at each other's throats.
events.name: The War of the Svaiyimlal Marches
events.backstory: Merchants complained of bribes and double charges at Lithf until Frigmo and Svaiyimlal chose swords over ledgers.

events.title: High water at Lavith
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Lavith stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 265 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Thieeliebrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: The Treaty of Lithf
events.text: Frigmo kneels, in the way such things are done, and Svaiyimlal rides home with Lithf and Flirlypor.

events.title: The new border at Lithf
events.text: Lithf is handed from Frigmo to Svaiyimlal.
events.backstory: Svaiyimlal claimed Lithf as the price of the War of the Svaiyimlal Marches, and Frigmo was in no position to refuse.

events.title: The new border at Flirlypor
events.text: The folk of Flirlypor wake to find themselves subjects of Svaiyimlal.
events.backstory: Flirlypor was one of the spoils of the War of the Svaiyimlal Marches, and changed hands in 268 without a single arrow.

events.title: The electors of Svaiyimlal choose
events.text: Delegates gather at Svaiyimvith and, after three days of argument, choose House Thyelydell to rule Svaiyimlal.
events.name: The Electors' Oath at Svaiyimvith
events.backstory: The custom of Svaiyimlal is to choose its rulers, and in 280 the electors passed over Alabrook for House Thyelydell.

events.title: Hierarch Naethar the Generous of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Naethar the Generous of House Thyelydell is raised as Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: Eliemere dies of thirst
events.text: No one at Eliemere can dig deeper, so the mill hamlet is left to the crows.

events.title: Mamere dies of thirst
events.text: The well at Mamere fails in a dry summer, and the hunters' lodge is left to the crows.

events.title: High water at Rotryr
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Rotryr.
events.name: The Drowning of Rotryr
events.backstory: A warm wind in 286 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Thieeliebrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: The Ofulm flood
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Ofulm and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Thieeliebrook over its banks in 292, and Ofulm was caught asleep.
